cards.text: Zechariah the prophet has been seeing visions, one after another (Zechariah 1:8-5:11). The angel who speaks with him has been showing him what they mean (Zechariah 1:9). Now he lifts up his eyes AGAIN, and something is coming out from between two mountains.

cards.question: What does Zechariah see coming out from between the two mountains?

cards.text: I spent YEARS staring at dust in a junk drawer, and Zechariah gets mountains of BRONZE. Not jealous, friend, just saying.
Red horses, black horses, white horses and dappled horses, one color for each chariot. Meanwhile I've worn the same white apron every single day since I got here.

cards.question: Zechariah says only the white horses are strong.

cards.text: Four chariots, four colors, ZERO explanation. Zechariah's looking at them like a driver looking at a brand-new warning light on the dashboard.

cards.question: Zechariah is looking at four chariots he doesn't understand. What does he do?

answers.text: Asks the angel what they are

cards.text: Zechariah asks, "What are these, my lord?" The angel tells him they are the four spirits of heaven.

cards.question: The angel says the four spirits of heaven are going forth. Where are they going forth from?

answers.text: Their station before the Lord of all the earth
The gates of the temple in Jerusalem
A house built in the land of Shinar

cards.question: Then the angel tells Zechariah where the chariots are headed. The one with the black horses is going toward the land of the ___.

cards.text: The angel keeps going. The white horses go toward the west, and the dappled horses? SOUTH.

cards.question: The angel tells Zechariah where three of the chariots are going. Which chariot does he never mention?

cards.text: These strong horses are EAGER to go. Like me when the oven timer dings, and I've singed my mustache twice racing to get there first.

cards.question: The horses are eager to go, but the LORD tells them to wait at the mountains a little longer.

cards.text: Instead the LORD says, "Go and patrol the earth." So off they go, and they patrol the earth.
Then the LORD summons Zechariah. He has news about the chariot with the black horses.

cards.question: The LORD's news is about the ones going to the land of the ___.
The LORD tells Zechariah that those going north have given rest to a spirit in the land of the north. Whose spirit is it?

findings.problem: The earlier cards give no clue that the black horses go north. The blank therefore asks the baker to guess unseen wording from Zechariah 6:6 rather than reason out the meaning.

rule.text: The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

findings.problem: Card 11 says that the white horses go west and the dappled horses go south. That rules out both wrong answers to this question and leaves the red horses by elimination before the baker is asked.

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
